content.short: Crazy Cats is a Cardano meme token project built around the CATS community, social campaigns, and playful branding.
content.description: Crazy Cats is a Cardano meme token project centered on the CATS token and a cat-themed community identity. The project presents itself as a playful social token rather than a complex DeFi protocol, using community participation, memes, and lightweight campaign links to promote the token. Its public pages emphasize entertainment, community energy, and Cardano-native meme culture. Crazy Cats gives holders a simple way to participate in a themed token community through wallets, swaps, and social activity.
